papers.label: Agentless
papers.implementation_lesson: Use a deterministic localize-first fallback when Council debate fails or produces no staged patches.
papers.acceptance_test: When Council produces no staged patches, Aura runs repo localization and returns <=5 candidate files without any model call.

papers.label: AutoCodeRover
papers.acceptance_test: Localizer uses AST parser to extract symbols, classes, functions and resolves their dependencies.

papers.label: SWE-agent
papers.implementation_lesson: ACI design: every Act Capsule exposes bounded commands.
papers.acceptance_test: Worker context provides constrained editing tools and diff generation guidelines.

papers.label: Empirical Research Assistance
papers.implementation_lesson: Adapt empirical software search into bounded Aura scorable tasks: define a local metric, generate or describe a candidate improvement, score verifier artifacts in a sandbox, record the candidate tree, and recommend promotion only when evidence improves.
papers.acceptance_test: Empirical lab task definitions are CODEMAP-grounded, candidate scores are reproducible from local metrics, UCB selection is deterministic, failed verifier evidence blocks promotion recommendations, and results are written to a JSONL candidate tree.
